subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

The rich man was known all throughout the country for his noble deeds, kindness and as __one who makes an active effort to promote__

__human welfare.__
solution:
The correct answer is "**Philanthropist**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate answer which means "**one who makes an active effort to promote human welfare**" is "**Philanthropist**".
 
• A **philanthropist** means a **person who helps the poor and needy by giving money**. 
 
 
• **Example:** *Sam paid fees for the slum children. He is a **philanthropist**. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, the answer is **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Squanderer** - a person who spends excessively. 

 
 
• **Example:** *Rita is a **squanderer** as she spent thousands on bags. *
 
 
 
• **Spendthrift** - a person who spends money wastefully.
 
 
• **Example:** *Jim loves shopping and is a **spendthrift**. *
 
 
 
• **Pacifist** - a person who is against war and violence. 
 
 
• **Example:** *I prefer sorting problems through words. I am a **pacifist**. *
